scope: On the Becoming core's laws of selection through a model of the options (Becoming.Selection, Relabel): PluralRecords' records are the core's models of the options Fin n, exchanging two centers is Relabel.swap, a rule treating the centers alike is a choice through the model, a lottery treating them alike has weights through the model, and holding an entry alone is Relabel.Alone. The core's laws give tied_not_served, all_tied_forces_withholding, servable_iff_untied (with PluralRecords.pick finding the center holding the entry alone), tied_equal_weight, full_tie_equal_weights, uniform_alike and point_mass_not_alike_at_tie, each with an empty axiom report. Whether an equal chance legitimately breaks a tie, and priority by claim size or by turn, keep the originals' scope.
